rules.TWO_CHOICE: if options contain ごめん → choose ごめん; else STOP=UNKNOWN_TWO_CHOICE
rules.THREE_CHOICE: choose middle option (option_index=2); no semantic analysis; no AGY
rules.OTHER: STOP=UNKNOWN_BUSINESS_CHOICE (option count !=2/3, uncertain count, unknown structure, occluded options, middle not clickable)
rules.PROMISE_EVENT: いいよ/ごめん → fixed ごめん (FIXED_DECLINE); no pending promise; no strategy change

detector: detect choice → count options → apply fixed policy (replaces 'BUSINESS_CHOICE 一律 STOP')
guard: 执行前确认: choice 类型、全部 option 可见、目标 option 可点; 感知不确定仍 fail-closed
